title: The Defenders
summary: Set a few months after the events of the second season of Daredevil, and a month after the events of Iron Fist, the vigilantes Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, and Iron Fist team up in New York City to fight a common enemy: The Hand. (source: IMDB)

reception.actors: Charlie Cox, Krysten Ritter, Mike Colter, Finn Jones, Sigourney Weaver
reception.awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 6 nominations total.
